history.summary: Devi Mandir in Ramna/Mithanpura, Muzaffarpur, dedicated to Goddess Durga and described as a Shaktipith; its golden statue of the Goddess is the prime attraction. Local listings date its establishment to 1941 (trendingnearme.com), though one visitor review calls it 'ati prachin' (very ancient) - conflict flagged. Coordinates are approximate (nearby Jubba Sahni Park/Club Road anchor) as no geocoder POI matched the temple itself.

name: Ramna Devi Mandir
town_description: Muzaffarpur is a major city in North Bihar and the commercial capital of the Tirhut region, famous worldwide for its Shahi litchi. It is a large railway junction about 70 km north of Patna.

travel.airport: Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, Patna (about 70 km)
travel.road: In the city centre at Ramna/Mithanpura, off Club Road; well connected by road to Patna and nearby cities

visitor_information.best_time: October-November (Navaratri/Durga Puja, when the temple sees maximum devotees)
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sources conflict: trendingnearme.com lists 10:00 AM-9:00 PM; Justdial listings show 6:30-10:00 AM or 9:00 AM-6:00 PM (verify before visiting)
